senses.gloss:
गोणी f. (-णी)
 1. Torn or ragged clothes.
 2. A sack.
 3. The measure of
a Drona.
 E. गुण् to reckon, affixes घञ् नि-गुणः and ङीष् the deriv. irr.

गोऽण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) A person with a prominent navel.
 m. (-ण्डः) A
man of a low tribe, a mountaineer, especially inhabiting the eastern
portion of the Vindhya range, between the Nerbudda and Krishna
giving name to the province of Gondwana.
 2. A prominent navel,
or a lump of flesh on the navel, &c.
 E. गुडि to enclose, &c. अच् aff.
